claims: Normalized monotone degree-one real lifts have displacement bounded by their positive period, uniformly over the lift.
The actual angular interpolation minus the angular projection equals the actual endpoint Taylor correction of displacement traces.
At any already selected delta with inverse at most U, raw positive endpoint jets through n+N bounded by B produce every full displacement jet through N bounded by C(n,N) U^(N+1) B.
Raw endpoint fields need only genuine one-sided strip smoothness and ordinary pointwise smoothness at the root circle. The chosen width and Taylor degree remain fixed.
limitations: The raw high-jet bound is an intermediate input awaiting the actual N01 root production estimate; this file does not assert a completed material or primitive bound.
No bound on the unbounded angular lift itself is assumed.
No common infinite-order collar is inferred from pointwise root smoothness.
